# Historical Decision Notes

## 2017: Attachment Storage

New attachments were moved from the database to a network share after database
growth affected backup duration. Existing attachments were not migrated.

## 2019: Central Intake

The organization approved routing all new cases through Central Intake. Later
support notes indicate that two departments now bypass this queue, but no
subsequent decision record was found.

## 2021: Local Team Administration

Supervisors received permission to manage team membership so operational
changes would not wait for central administration.

## 2023: Modernization Preparation

The technology group rejected another major framework upgrade because the
application structure and automated-test coverage made the change difficult
to assess. A replacement study was requested.

These notes do not identify which historical decisions remain binding for the
target application.
